model_annotations.Bulgarian: Figure 4 presents two line plots side by side, both illustrating the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output values before and after gating, with different threshold settings. The left plot corresponds to a threshold of 1e-2, while the right plot corresponds to a threshold of 1e-3. Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Layer," which ranges from 0 to 20 in increments of 5, using a linear scale. The y-axis in both plots is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, also on a linear scale. Each plot contains three lines: a dashed green line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.02" (left) or "avg 0.003" (right), a dash-dotted red line for the "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.64" (left) or "avg 0.126" (right), and a dotted blue line for the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33" (left) or "avg 0.088" (right). In both plots, the dashed green line remains nearly constant at the bottom of the y-axis, indicating very low sparsity before gating. The dash-dotted red line starts near the top of the y-axis (close to 1.0) and decreases gradually across layers, ending near 0.6 in the left plot and near 0.1 in the right plot. The dotted blue line also starts high and decreases, ending near 0.3 in the left plot and near 0.09 in the right plot. The overall trend in both plots shows that the sparsity ratio decreases with increasing layer depth after gating, with the magnitude of sparsity being lower when the threshold is reduced from 1e-2 to 1e-3.
model_annotations.Chinese: Figure 4 displays two line plots side by side, each illustrating the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below a specified threshold across different layers of a model. The x-axis in both plots is labeled "Layer" and spans from 0 to 20 with linearly spaced tick marks at intervals of 5, indicating the layer index. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with linear tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The left plot is titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2" and contains three lines: a green dashed line labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", a blue dash-dotted line labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", and a red dotted line labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33". All three lines begin near 1.0 at layer 0 and decrease monotonically as layer increases, with the green dashed line remaining above the other two throughout. The right plot is titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3" and also contains three lines: a green dashed line labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003", a blue dash-dotted line labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126", and a red dotted line labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.089". These lines similarly start near 1.0 at layer 0 and decline across layers, with the green dashed line again positioned above the other two. The figure caption states that the mean absolute values before and after gating are similar.
model_annotations.English: Figure 4 displays two line plots side by side, illustrating the mean absolute values of SDPA output before and after gating, with the caption noting that baseline and post-gating values are similar. Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Layer," which ranges from 0 to 20 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Mean Absolute Value" and spans from 0.0 to 1.0, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Each plot contains three lines: a dashed green line representing "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.02" (which remains nearly flat near 0.02 across all layers), a solid green line for "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44" (which starts near 0.44 and remains relatively stable with minor fluctuations), and a dash-dotted green line for "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33" (which begins near 0.33 and shows slight variation). The left plot is titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2," while the right plot is titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3." The lines in both plots exhibit minimal change across layers, indicating consistent sparsity ratios regardless of layer depth or threshold.
model_annotations.German: Figure 4 displays two line plots side by side, each illustrating the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below a specified threshold, before and after gating, as a function of layer depth. Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Layer," which ranges from 0 to 20 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," spans from 0.0 to 1.0 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The left plot corresponds to a threshold of 1e-2, while the right plot corresponds to a threshold of 1e-3. In both plots, three lines are shown: a dashed gray line representing the sparsity ratio before gating (average value 0.033 in the left plot, 0.003 in the right), a solid green line representing the sparsity ratio after gating (average value 0.64 in the left plot, 0.126 in the right), and a dotted gray line representing the sparsity ratio after averaging the gating score with the pre-gating hidden state (average value 0.33 in the left plot, 0.088 in the right). In the left plot, the dashed gray line starts at approximately 0.033 at layer 0 and remains nearly flat across all layers. The solid green line starts at approximately 0.64 at layer 0 and decreases gradually to about 0.4 at layer 20. The dotted gray line begins at approximately 0.33 at layer 0 and also decreases slightly to around 0.25 at layer 20. In the right plot, the dashed gray line starts at approximately 0.003 at layer 0 and remains nearly constant. The solid green line begins at approximately 0.126 at layer 0 and decreases to about 0.05 at layer 20. The dotted gray line starts at approximately 0.088 at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.03 at layer 20. The figure caption states that the mean absolute values before and after gating are similar.
